_comment: Ratchet for scripts/ci/raw-status-leak-guard.mjs (UX-003). maxViolations is the live count measured on the fix/ux-003 branch after fixing procurement/planning/new, hr/payroll/CreatePayrollRunForm, citizen/grievances/new, and procurement/indents/new/CreateIndentForm (down from 172 pre-fix). It must only ever move DOWN, in the same PR that fixes the corresponding files — see follow-up gap UX-016 in docs/ENTERPRISE-GAP-REPORT-2026-09-07.md for the tracked remainder. UX-016 tranche 1 (fix/ux-016) fixed the entire works/ module (17 violations across 10 files: works/_data/client.ts, works/approvals/ApprovalFinalizeButton.tsx, works/billing/[workId]/BillingActions.tsx, works/billing/account-compile/page.tsx, works/contractors/[id]/ContractorEditToggle.tsx, works/execution/[workId]/ExecutionActions.tsx, works/proposals/[id]/ProposalActions.tsx, works/proposals/[id]/ProposalEditToggle.tsx, works/proposals/[id]/ProposalExtActions.tsx, works/tenders/[id]/TenderActions.tsx), lowering the count from 169 to 152. 152 remain across the other modules — re-run the guard for the current file:line list before starting the next tranche. UX-020 EXCEPTION to 'only ever moves down': 152 -> 261 on fix/ux-020 is a detection-strength jump, not a regression or a bulk-unfix — independent review of UX-016's own 'done' works/ module found 6 real leaks the pre-UX-020 regex structurally could not see (un-parenthesized `${res.status}` template interpolation, `String(res.status)`, and hardcoded '<Verb> failed' fallbacks other than the one literal 'Request failed' phrase the guard checked for). Strengthening the regex to close those holes (see raw-status-leak-guard.mjs's doc comment) made 109 more pre-existing, already-live violations visible fleet-wide (152 -> 261) without a single new leak landing — confirmed by diffing the file:line list before/after the regex change, not just the count. UX-020's OTHER fix (browserClient.ts's errorMessageFromResponse, see the gap report) incidentally fixed its own `API_ERROR: ${res.status}` fallback as part of routing through toHumanError, which happened to also be one of the 261 the strengthened regex could now see (apps/web/src/lib/api/browserClient.ts:56) — a real, verified fix, so 261 -> 260 the normal way this ratchet always moves down: re-ran the guard after the browserClient.ts change and confirmed the count dropped by exactly that one file:line, nothing else. 260 remain (259 from the detection-jump set, un-fixed; UX-020 does not fix the 6 named works/ sites either — proving detection was the DoD, see the gap report). Re-run the guard for the current file:line list before starting the next fix tranche, same as UX-016's own instruction above.
